en.title: Billing settings
en.summary: How big a discount the front desk may give before a manager has to approve it.

sections.heading: The discount limit
sections.body: A bill issued with a discount over this share of it waits in Approvals → Discounts and Voids, and takes no payment until a manager approves it. 10% unless changed. 0 sends every discount to a manager; 100 sends none.

sections.heading: Tax
sections.body: Enter the clinic's TIN: it is printed on every bill. If the clinic is registered for VAT, tick VAT and set the rate (15% by default). Bills then charge VAT on lines marked VAT applies — goods sold, such as a toothbrush — after any discount, and print it as its own line. Treatment is not taxed unless you tick Treatment, since medical services are exempt as this system understands Ethiopian VAT law; ask your accountant. A change applies to bills issued from now on; an issued bill keeps the rate it was issued at.

am.title: የክፍያ ቅንብሮች
am.summary: የፊት ዴስኩ ሥራ አስኪያጅ ሳያጸድቅ ምን ያህል ቅናሽ መስጠት እንደሚችል።

sections.heading: የቅናሽ ገደቡ
sections.body: ከዚህ ድርሻ በላይ ቅናሽ ተደርጎበት የወጣ ሂሳብ በApprovals → Discounts and Voids ይጠብቃል፤ ሥራ አስኪያጅ እስኪያጸድቅም ክፍያ አይቀበልም። ካልተቀየረ 10%። 0 ሁሉንም ቅናሽ ወደ ሥራ አስኪያጅ ይልካል፤ 100 ምንም አይልክም።

sections.heading: ግብር
sections.body: የክሊኒኩን የግብር ከፋይ መለያ ቁጥር (TIN) ያስገቡ፤ በእያንዳንዱ ሂሳብ ላይ ይታተማል። ክሊኒኩ ለተ.እ.ታ ከተመዘገበ «VAT»ን ምልክት አድርገው መጠኑን ያስቀምጡ (በነባሪ 15%)። ከዚያ ሂሳቦች «ተ.እ.ታ ይከፈልበታል» በተባሉ መስመሮች ላይ — እንደ የጥርስ ብሩሽ ያሉ የተሸጡ ዕቃዎች — ከቅናሽ በኋላ ተ.እ.ታ ያስከፍላሉ። የሕክምና አገልግሎቶች ነፃ ስለሆኑ «Treatment» ካልተመረጠ ሕክምና ግብር አይከፈልበትም፤ የሂሳብ ባለሙያዎን ይጠይቁ። ለውጥ ከዚህ በኋላ ለሚወጡ ሂሳቦች ይሠራል።
